none: PAS CAM-1B7581: Roman Coin : Incomplete copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine AD 350-384 - phoenix on rocky ground
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine AD 350-384 (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse shows a phoenix right, on rocky mound. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse surface is damaged and illegible, it might possibly just show a tint of detail to possibly suggest an uncertain 6 o'clock die axis. Weight is 1.41g, diameter is 17.3mm, thickness…
